comment: The architecture assigns meaning to the Terminology Service and structure to the LIMR. As noted in Section 3.5, information models also carry contextual semantics, so the dictionary-and-grammar analogy is useful but incomplete.

public.text: The architecture assigns meaning to the Terminology Service and structure to the LIMR. As noted in Section 3.5, information models also carry contextual semantics, so the dictionary-and-grammar analogy is useful but incomplete.
public.suggestedRevision: State that the Terminology Service governs coded concept meaning, while the LIMR governs structure, context, constraints, and terminology bindings. Both contribute to semantic meaning.
